run_GetCommandOutput: run a shell command and return its stdout as a list of stripped lines
run_GetSvnInfo: run svn info to get the project name and SVN workspace root path
run_GetSvnTrunk: run GetSvnTrunk to return the current SVN workspace trunk root path
run_IsInGTestSvn: run IsInGTestSvn to check if the current directory is in the googletest SVN repo
run_IsInGMockSvn: run IsInGMockSvn to check if the current directory is in the googlemock SVN repo
